entities.name: Express Checkout Event
entities.description: Raw event table capturing the Express Checkout feature user interactions.

entities.name: Group Application Event
entities.description: Raw event table capturing group/family application flow events.

entities.name: Visa Status Sharing Event
entities.description: Raw event table capturing the Visa Status Sharing feature user interactions.

entities.name: Abandoned Checkout Recovery Event
entities.description: Raw event table capturing the abandoned checkout recovery flow events (abandonment_detected, reminder_sent, reminder_opened, reminder_cta_clicked, resumed_at_step, reconverted).

entities.name: Instant Forex Add-on Event
entities.description: Raw event table capturing the Instant Forex Add-on feature user interactions.

relationships.reason: All eight event tables join on user_id, the traveller identity.
Application created at application_started; later funnel steps reference the same application_id.
pay_now_clicked belongs to the application started earlier in the funnel.
purchase_completed is the conversion event for a given application.
Supporting events (search_typed, landing_page_scrolled, auth_completed) join on user_id and may precede an application, so application_id can be empty.
Join Express events to core user activity tables via user_id
Link Express events to the application context
Join recovery events to core user activity via user_id.
Link recovery events to the original application funnel.
Join forex add‑on events to core checkout events for per‑user funnel analysis.
Link add‑on events to the same checkout session via application_id.

metrics.name: conversion_rate
metrics.description: Headline metric reported to leadership.

metrics.name: drop_off_rate
metrics.description: Per funnel stage: 1 - (users at stage N+1 / users at stage N), counting distinct user_id reaching each stage in order within the window.
metrics.numerator: uniq(user_id) at stage N - uniq(user_id) at stage N+1

metrics.name: step_through_rate
metrics.description: Users at stage N+1 divided by users at stage N.

metrics.name: passport_capture_pass_rate
metrics.description: Document uploads that did not cross the failed-capture threshold, divided by all document uploads.

metrics.name: on_time_delivery_rate
metrics.description: Applications issued on or before visa_issuance_eta_days, divided by applications issued. Reported by the fulfilment team from post-purchase systems; not computable from the funnel tables here.
metrics.numerator: count(applications issued on or before visa_issuance_eta_days)

metrics.name: revenue_per_conversion
metrics.description: value on purchase_completed, in the event's currency.

metrics.name: funnel_conversion_rate
metrics.description: Within the funnel, conversion is purchase_completed users divided by users who started an application (application_started). This is the denominator used in the drop-off dashboards.

metrics.name: express_conversion_rate
metrics.description: Rate of users who see the Express button and complete payment.

metrics.name: otp_success_rate
metrics.description: Proportion of OTP entries that succeed.

metrics.name: express_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Share of users who tap the Express button after it is shown.

metrics.name: average_payment_latency_ms
metrics.description: Average latency of successful Express payments.

metrics.name: express_payment_latency_ms
metrics.description: Average time between Express button shown and payment confirmed.
metrics.numerator: avgIf(timestampDiff('millisecond', minIf(timestamp, event = 'express_checkout_shown'), maxIf(timestamp, event = 'express_payment_confirmed')), event = 'express_payment_confirmed')

metrics.name: group_completion_rate
metrics.description: Proportion of groups that reach submission step.

metrics.name: add_remove_churn_rate
metrics.description: Rate of traveller removals relative to additions per group.

metrics.name: docs_complete_rate
metrics.description: Average document completion flag among added travellers.

metrics.name: share_rate_overall
metrics.description: Proportion of events that result in a share click.

metrics.name: share_rate_by_status
metrics.description: Share click rate segmented by status_shared.

metrics.name: share_rate_by_channel_destination
metrics.description: Share click rate by channel and destination.

metrics.name: new_user_open_rate_by_channel
metrics.description: Rate of new‑user link opens per generated link, by channel.

metrics.name: k_factor_by_channel
metrics.description: Recipient CTA click rate per new‑user link open, by channel.

metrics.name: link_generation_adoption
metrics.description: Proportion of share clicks that generate a link.

metrics.name: link_open_rate
metrics.description: Proportion of generated links that are opened.

metrics.name: overall_recovery_rate
metrics.description: Overall reconversion rate: reconverted users divided by abandonment detections.

metrics.name: recovery_rate_by_drop_step
metrics.description: Recovery rate per drop step: reconverted users divided by abandonment detections for each drop_step.

metrics.name: channel_recovery_rate
metrics.description: Recovery rate per channel: reconverted users divided by reminders sent for each channel.

metrics.name: timing_recovery_rate
metrics.description: Recovery rate per hours_since_drop bucket: reconverted users divided by reminders sent for each hours_since_drop value.

metrics.name: forex_attach_rate
metrics.description: Rate of users who purchase the forex add‑on after seeing the offer.

metrics.name: forex_add_to_cart_rate
metrics.description: Rate of users who add the forex add‑on to cart after seeing the offer.

metrics.name: forex_purchase_after_add_rate
metrics.description: Rate of users who purchase after adding the forex add‑on to cart.

metrics.name: average_forex_addon_value_inr
metrics.description: Average addon value in INR for purchased forex add‑on.

known_issues.title: iOS WebKit OTP autofill regression
known_issues.description: payment OTP field fails to autofill on recent iOS builds; some users abandon at the pay step. Payment-heavy geos (Gulf card users) most exposed. Watch pay_now_clicked -> purchase_completed for iOS.

known_issues.title: Passport scan model update (Apr 2026)
known_issues.description: on-device passport model updated early April; some Android devices report more capture failures since; being monitored.

known_issues.title: MRZ OCR weaker on non-Latin passports
known_issues.description: passports with non-Latin machine-readable zones need more capture retries.

known_issues.title: Schengen summer slot scarcity (Apr-Jun)
known_issues.description: appointment slots for Schengen destinations are scarce in summer; expect seasonal softness, not a bug.

known_issues.title: WhatsApp nudge launch (Feb 2026)
known_issues.description: a WhatsApp re-engagement nudge went live in February; can lift returns to the funnel for previously-dropped users.

known_issues.title: SUMMER20 coupon campaign
known_issues.description: a SUMMER20 promo ran in Q2; expect elevated coupon_applied and lower realised value.

known_issues.title: App 7.45 rollout
known_issues.description: app version 7.45.x rolled out mid-quarter; minor funnel-timing shifts around the rollout are expected.

naming_conventions: event column stores the name of the raw event (e.g., express_checkout_shown)
eligible flag indicates whether the user was eligible for Express at the time of the event
share_id is the primary entity key used to join sharer and recipient events within the Visa Status Sharing flow.
